title: Escalator story thread
content: I’d like to hear everyone’s experiences with escalators. Last night I tried going up an escalator but a woman (the only person around) came up to me and told me not to go up it. I did anyways and it was like trying to walk up a larger version of a bike chain or chain saw chain and it was hard to move. I eventually got off and crawled up a random water slide in the mall. I remember when I was younger (15yrs ago)getting on an escalator in my mall dream and I made me realize I was dreaming because of how weird it was and I just started flying and flew out of mall world. These are the only two encounters with escalator that I actually remember.
